title: Germany 30-Year Bund multi-ISIN auction (EUR 2.5bn across two reopening lines) — CPI and Beige Book day
source: EST: deutsche-finanzagentur.de English issuance calendar (/en/federal-securities/issuances/issuance-calendar), fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 125,468 bytes) — the Quarter IV 2026 table lists TWO 30-year reopening lines dated 14.10.2026, 'Bund 30 Y (R)' at EUR 1.5bn and 'Bund 30 Y (R)' at EUR 1.0bn, both with the ISIN, coupon and maturity shown as '-'. Both dashes are expected rather than missing data: the same site's auction-process page states that for multi-ISIN auctions in the 15- and 30-year segment 'the benchmark bonds to be reopened are not finalised until the quarterly calendars are updated' and that the second bond is 'only announced in a press notice in the week before the auction', with all multi-ISIN auctions announced four bank business days ahead — which for Wednesday 14.10.2026 falls on 2026-10-08. The date and the EUR 2.5bn total are the calendar's; the identities of the two bonds are not yet published. The same Q4 table carries 11.11.2026 (Bund 30 Y (R) EUR 1.5bn + EUR 1.0bn) and 04.11.2026 (two Bund 15 Y (R) lines at EUR 1.0bn each), recorded here and not filed. Filed estimate on the same mechanical count as its proposer: market-events-data.ts defines no confirmed source prefix for a non-US sovereign debt office, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: Discovered during the bund-30y-auction-2026-09-16 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-09). It is the direct next observation for that ledger's two live forward tests — FT-bund-30y-auction-2026-09-16-1 (the measured null: a German 30Y auction result does not move the same-date US 30Y CMT, t = -0.06 across 213 dates since 2003) and FT-bund-30y-auction-2026-09-16-2 (allotment, not cover, is the informative number: 2022-26 30Y retention averages 18.6%, so EUR 2.5bn offered implies ~EUR 2.04bn allotted) — and it is the same EUR 2.5bn two-line shape, so the comparison is like-for-like. Adjacent to events this calendar already tracks: cpi-2026-10-14 and beige-book-2026-10-14 fall on the same date, ppi-2026-10-15, retail-sales-2026-10-15 and treasury-coupon-announcement-2026-10-15 the next, and fomc-blackout-start-2026-10-17 three days later — so the same attribution service the 09-16 entry buys on FOMC day applies here on CPI day. Tiered `low` and NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED, for the same three reasons as its proposer: no house playbook is rates-keyed, no tracked symbol carries euro-rates exposure, and the spillover was tested and returned a null. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
